- [USER] User asked if any famous movies came out during the Roaring Twenties.
- [ASSISTANT_SAID] The Jazz Singer (1927) - The first feature-length film with synchronized sound, starring Al Jolson.

- [ASSISTANT_SAID] Sunrise: A Song of Two Humans (1927) - A silent film directed by F.W. Murnau that won multiple Academy Awards.
- [ASSISTANT_SAID] The General (1926) - A silent comedy film directed by Buster Keaton, now hailed as a classic.
- [ASSISTANT_SAID] The Kid (1921) - A silent film directed by Charlie Chaplin, favored by many film lovers and critics.
